entries.name: QUO_API_KEY
entries.description: An API key for the store's Quo (formerly OpenPhone) workspace, sent as the Authorization header. Quo keys have full access to the workspace's API, so the same key could send texts or change contacts; the connector only ever sends List calls and List messages. It goes only to Quo.
howToGet: A Quo workspace owner or admin opens Workspace Settings > API and creates a key named for KaratOS alone, so it can be deleted on its own.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
